# Dyskans React

Darnow-oberow tyskys, unn restren pub onan, kontrollys gans an patrom `value` + `onChange` standard — pubtra a ober fatell wra React seulajys.

## Pyth a wrewgh drehevel

Furv kestava byghan — mewnos gans lavell, botton danvon, stad kontrollys, hwedhel klavyer ha skrin-redyer gwir — kynsa noeth, ena stylys, yn a-dro dhe 10 mynysenn.

## Kyns dalleth

Ty a'n jeves othom a git, Node 22 po nowodhyes, ha pnpm 10 po nowodhyes. Raglen React 18+ vyth a ober — Next.js, Vite, po React plen.

## Kamm 1 — Kevewgh an koodh

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-react-headless
pnpm install
pnpm test        # vitest + @testing-library/react
pnpm run storybook   # browse all 608 components
```

An darnow yw restrennow plat yn `components/` — `Button.tsx`, `TextInput.tsx` — pub onan gans y brov, story, ha dhogynnans ryb. Kopiewgh an restrennow a'n jeves othom dhe'th app, po vendorewgh an gwithva hag enporthewgh dhiworto.

## Kamm 2 — Dha dharn kynsa

```
import Button from "lily-design-system-react-headless/components/Button";

export function SaveBar() {
  return <Button onClick={save}>Save</Button>;
}
```

Dyskwedh `<button class="button" type="button">`. Perthynasow: `type`, `disabled`, `pressed` (a dhyskwedh `aria-pressed`), `label` ( `aria-label` gorholans), `className`, ha peub perthynas ekstra a lesans war an elven wreydh.

## Kamm 3 — Kesstrewewgh furv byghan

```
import { useState } from "react";
import Form from ".../components/Form";
import Field from ".../components/Field";
import TextInput from ".../components/TextInput";
import Button from ".../components/Button";

export function ContactForm() {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  return (
    <Form label="Contact form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <Field label="Full name" required>
        <TextInput id="name" label="Full name" value={name} onChange={setName} required />
      </Field>
      <Button type="submit">Save</Button>
    </Form>
  );
}
```

`Field` a gemmer an `label` avel perthynas y honan yn le darn lavell nessys — passewgh hi unnweyth, war `Field`ha `TextInput`kehevelys war `label` a re an hanow hedhesys.

**Gwiriys 2026-08-29:** kynsa towl a nesas darn dyvers `Label` a-berth `Field`, hag a dhyskwedhas *dew* lavell (unn gwag) drefen `Field` seulajys a dhyskwedh y honan dhiworth an `label` perthynas — kefys dre gesolya an snippet ewn. An [fordh furv-kestava kesstrewys](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/lily-design-system-react-next-examples/app/contact-form/page.tsx) yw an keth patrom, previys gans e2e ha axe gwir.

## Kamm 4 — Stylyewgh

Pubtra a-ugh a vydh dyskwedhys avel strewyans pur, parys rag dha stilyow. Stylyewgh an krogow — `.button`, `.text-input`, `.label`, `.field` — yn dha folen-stil, gorrewgh toulys Tailwind dre `className`, po kevrewgh tebel parys:

```
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/united-states-web-design-system.css" />
```

## Kamm 5 — Gwelewgh pubtra ow ’oberi

An [App ensampel Next.js](https://lilydesignsystem.com/kw-001/examples/) yw an rolyans kowl stylys ha displetys, gans Playwright e2e ha linenn-selys axe-core:

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-react-next-examples
pnpm install && pnpm run dev
```
